budget_items.topic: Outreach worker reduction and new Custodian item
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Level Funded budget reduced the outreach worker item and added a new Custodian item at 10 hours per week, with the same dollar figure.
budget_items.quote: the changes are reducing outreach worker item by $5,204 and including a new item - custodian for $5,204 (10 hours per week).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Override budget included contractual salary increases, most of the outreach worker item, and more custodial hours, bringing the personnel subtotal to the printed figure.
Non-union items would have reflected planned increases of 3%.
budget_items.quote: the non-union items would have reflected planned increases of 3%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee noted that Outreach also receives Formula Grant Funds to fulfill its function; no dollar figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: it must be remembered that outreach also receives formula grant funds to fulfill this important function.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Electricity, heating (natural gas) and sewer receive a 5% increase in the Override budget; water is increased by 25% because six months' costs already met the 2012 budgeted amount.
budget_items.quote: water charges are increased by 25%, as this year's 6 month's costs has already met the 2012 budgeted amount.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Postage, office supplies and mileage reimbursement receive a 10% increase; the committee found these reasonable.
budget_items.quote: items receiving 10% are postage, office supplies, and mileage reimbursement.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Training & Licenses item of $500 was added to the Override budget for licenses and training such as ServeSafe for kitchen staff and supervision.
budget_items.quote: an item for training & licenses was added for $500 that would cover costs of licenses and training needed for selected employees

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Level Funded budget totals as printed on the spreadsheet: total expenses and total budget (Total Salaries & Wages printed as $95,603.00; Electricity $9,352.00).
Override budget totals as printed on the spreadsheet: total expenses and total budget (Total Salaries & Wages printed as $105,447.00; Training & Licenses $500.00).
